name: LLMs.txt Generator & AI Visibility by aiready.tools
author: aireadytools

sections.description:
Most llms.txt plugins – and now your SEO plugin too – write a list of links. AI assistants cannot recommend a shop from a list of links.

This plugin writes what ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity actually need to recommend you: your products with real prices, availability, brand and SKU straight from WooCommerce, your categories, and the pages that answer customer questions. It then measures whether it worked.

What you get that a link list cannot give you

  • Product data, not URLs – prices, stock status, brands, SKUs and short descriptions in llms.txt and llms-full.txt. Free mode already includes product names, prices, categories and stock.
  • AI Visibility Score (0–100) – five measured sub-scores: Schema.org coverage, llms.txt health, AI crawler access in robots.txt, noindex compliance, content quality (Pro). Every check shows the measured value, not just a traffic light.
  • Does any AI mention you? – the connected platform asks ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity one real industry question without your brand name in it and shows whether you are named and who is named instead (free, once a day, on aiready.tools).
  • GEO audit of your whole site – 8 analysis modules on aiready.tools with a prioritised action plan and ready-to-paste snippets; the plugin links straight to it.
  • Drill-down & intent routing (Pro) – your top products in depth and 26 customer question types mapped to the right pages.
  • Weekly monitoring (Pro Business) – asks the AI engines every week and e-mails you only when something changes.

Honest about results: nobody can guarantee that an AI will cite you. The plugin makes you readable and measurable; whether mentions follow depends on your content and your market. That is why everything above is free to try for 30 days – no payment details, ends by itself, the same key continues in any plan afterwards.

Free for every WordPress site: generation, serving at /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt via rewrite rules (no physical file), auto-regeneration via WP-Cron, noindex detection (Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, AIOSEO), robots.txt respect, REST webhook for CI/CD, German and English UI. No account, and in free mode no data leaves your server.

Free features

  • Generates llms.txt from WordPress pages, posts, and WooCommerce products with prices and stock status
  • Serves /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt via WordPress rewrite rules — no physical file needed
  • Auto-regenerates when posts or products are saved
  • Custom Markdown sections appended to output
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • SEO plugin noindex detection (Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, AIOSEO) — noindexed pages excluded automatically
  • URL exclusion list with wildcard support
  • Optional respect for robots.txt Disallow rules
  • Full German (de_DE) and English translation support

Pro features (via llmstxtgenerator.de API)

The Pro mode offloads generation to a dedicated crawling API. This enables features that require full-page analysis beyond what WordPress data alone provides:

  • Product Drill-Down: Price, brand, availability and SKU of your top-selling products, taken straight from WooCommerce (since 1.8.1) — so your llms.txt states your real prices
  • Intent Routing: 26 customer question types (price, comparison, availability, installation, warranty…) mapped to the correct pages on your site
  • Categories and brands: Product categories, brands, calculators and guides as separate sections
  • Crawl of your other pages: Home page, blog, FAQ and legal pages are crawled and described in llms.txt and llms-full.txt
  • Priority email support

Pro tiers — pick the right size

  • Pro Solo — €4.90/month · up to 500 URLs per generation · 10 domains/month · ideal for small WordPress sites and single shops
  • Pro Business — €9.90/month · up to 2,000 URLs · unlimited domains · automatic cron updates · weekly AI mention monitoring (1 domain, 10 questions) · ideal for established shops
  • Agency — €19.90/month · up to 10,000 URLs · REST API access · monitoring for 3 domains · white-label PDF reports · ideal for agencies managing multiple client sites

GEO audits on aiready.tools are unlimited in every paid plan (fair use) and free once per domain and day without an account.

Try before you buy: a free 30-day trial unlocks Pro Business – in the plugin, in the web generator and on aiready.tools – with no payment details. It ends automatically; the same key then continues in any plan. Start it at llmstxtgenerator.de/en/trial/ (German: /test/).

The plugin auto-detects which tier your licence key belongs to and displays the active tier and URL limit in the admin sidebar after key verification.

Get your Pro key at llmstxtgenerator.de/pro/

AI Visibility Score (overview card, since 1.4.0)

  • Lighthouse-style 0-100 score with 5 weighted sub-scores
  • Schema.org Coverage (30%) — checks Product schema on WooCommerce products
  • llms.txt Health (25%) — file exists, has sections, fresh, has llms-full.txt
  • AI Crawler Access (15%) — robots.txt allows GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot etc.
  • Content Quality (15%, Pro) — title length, meta-description, H1, alt-tags, OG-tags
  • noindex Compliance (15%) — Yoast/RankMath/AIOSEO noindex pages excluded from llms.txt
  • Smart Recommendations — top 3 actionable fixes with one-click buttons

AI Visibility Score Detail Page (NEW in 1.5.0)

A dedicated drill-down page accessible via LLMs.txt → AI Visibility Score:

  • Schema.org drill-down — table of every sampled product with @type / price / offers status, plus direct edit links for products with missing markup
  • llms.txt diagnostic grid — every health check (exists, hasTitle, hasSections, hasEnoughPages, fresh, hasFullVersion) with raw values and tooltip explanations
  • Crawler matrix — six AI bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider, CCBot) with allow/block status, plus an auto-generated robots.txt snippet for the blocked ones, with one-click copy
  • Content Quality breakdown (Pro) — 10/25/50 sample pages (Solo / Business / Agency) × 5 checks each (title length, meta description, H1, alt-tag ratio, Open-Graph tags) — every cell shows the precise value, not just pass/fail
  • noindex conflicts — every page flagged noindex by Yoast / Rank Math / AIOSEO / SEOPress / WooCommerce, with source badge and a flag whether the page still appears in your llms.txt
  • 30-day score history (Pro) — SVG sparkline of your visibility score with daily snapshots, 7-day delta, and tier-coloured data points
  • Export — JSON dump of the full audit, or a ZIP archive containing five separate CSVs (one per sub-score) for sharing with clients, agencies, or your reporting pipeline
  • Re-Crawl now (Pro) — force a fresh Pro-API crawl with a 30-minute cooldown
  • Clickable sub-score bars on the main page jump directly to the matching drill-down section

What is llms.txt?

llms.txt is an open standard (llmstxt.org) — a structured Markdown file in your site root that tells AI systems who you are, what you offer, and where to find your key content. Early adopters gain a significant advantage as AI assistants increasingly cite structured sources over unstructured web pages.

WooCommerce support

When WooCommerce is active, the plugin automatically includes your product catalog with names, prices, categories, stock status, and short descriptions. WooCommerce system pages (cart, checkout, my account) are automatically excluded.

Privacy

In free mode, no data leaves your server. In Pro mode, the plugin transmits your public website URL, your licence key and (since 1.8.0) the selected products with name, price, availability, brand, SKU and short description — only information your shop already shows publicly. No revenue or sales figures, no customer data and no personal data of your visitors are transmitted. See “External services” below for details.

External services

In free mode, this plugin operates entirely on your own server. No data is sent to any external service.

In Pro mode, this plugin connects to the llmstxtgenerator.de API to generate an AI-optimised llms.txt file for your site, and (since 1.5.0) to fetch detailed Content Quality data for the AI Visibility Score detail page.

  • What the service does: Crawls your public website and generates a structured llms.txt and llms-full.txt with product drill-down, intent routing, categories and brands. For the score detail page, it crawls 10–50 sample pages (depending on your tier) to score titles, meta-descriptions, H1, alt-tags and OG-tags per page.
  • What data is sent: Your public website URL and your Pro licence key. Since 1.8.0 also the ranked list of the selected product URLs, and since 1.8.1 for each selected product its name, price, currency, availability, brand, SKU and short description — data your shop already displays publicly. Revenue and sales figures, customer data and personal data of your visitors are never transmitted.
  • When data is sent: Only in Pro mode: when you verify your licence key, click “Generate Now” or “Re-Crawl now”; when the AI Visibility Score is computed (cached for six hours); and, if automatic updates are enabled, when a regeneration runs after content changes (bundled, at least two hours apart), during the nightly run between 01:00 and 04:00 site time and after a change of the site address.
  • Service provider: llmstxtgenerator.de, operated by André Hülsmann, Steinstr. 13, D-37242 Bad Sooden-Allendorf, Germany.
  • Terms of service: https://llmstxtgenerator.de/agb/
  • Privacy policy: https://llmstxtgenerator.de/datenschutz/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the aiready-llms-txt-generator folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins > Installed Plugins in WordPress
  3. Click LLMs.txt in the admin sidebar
  4. Click ⚡ Generate Now — your /llms.txt is live immediately
  5. Optional: switch to Pro mode and enter your licence key (Solo, Business or Agency) for enhanced output

Minimum requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 8.0 or higher
sections.faq:
Does this slow down my website?

No. The llms.txt file is served via a lightweight rewrite rule and cached for one hour. Regeneration runs asynchronously via WP-Cron after content changes, not during the page load.

Does it work without WooCommerce?

Yes — it works with any WordPress site and includes pages and blog posts. WooCommerce product data is automatically included when WooCommerce is detected.

What is the difference between llms.txt and llms-full.txt?

llms.txt is a concise summary optimised for most AI assistants. llms-full.txt contains extended descriptions and is intended for AI crawlers that fetch additional context. Both files are generated and served automatically.

How does the AI Visibility Score detail page work?

The detail page (added in 1.5.0) is a separate sub-menu under LLMs.txt. The main settings page keeps the score as a compact card; the detail page lets you drill down into each sub-score individually — every product, every check, every blocked crawler is visible with the underlying value, not just a percentage. Re-Crawl on demand (Pro), export the audit as JSON or as a ZIP of five CSVs, and watch the 30-day history sparkline build up automatically (snapshots are recorded with every score computation, every 6 hours).

Which Pro tier do I need?

It depends on your site size:

  • Pro Solo (€4.90/month) — small WordPress sites and single shops up to 500 URLs. Includes drill-down, intent routing and 10 domains/month.
  • Pro Business (€9.90/month) — established shops with up to 2,000 URLs. Adds unlimited domains, automatic cron updates and weekly AI mention monitoring for one domain.
  • Agency (€19.90/month) — large operations or agencies managing multiple client sites. Up to 10,000 URLs, REST API access, monitoring for 3 domains, white-label PDF.

Audits on aiready.tools are unlimited in all paid plans (fair use).

The plugin accepts all three key types and automatically detects which tier you bought.

Can I try Pro before buying?

Yes. The free 30-day trial gives you a Pro Business key with no payment details and no subscription – it simply ends after 30 days. Enter the key in the plugin like any Pro key; the sidebar shows the end date. To continue afterwards, pick a plan on llmstxtgenerator.de – the same key is unlocked again, nothing has to be set up twice.

How do I see which tier my key belongs to?

After clicking “Verify” with your Pro key, the admin sidebar shows your active tier (Pro Solo / Pro Business / Agency) and the URL limit per generation. The information comes directly from the licensing API.

Is the plugin GDPR-compliant?

Yes. In free mode, no data leaves your server. In Pro mode, only your public website URL, your licence key and publicly visible product data (name, price, availability, brand, SKU, short description) are sent to the llmstxtgenerator.de API — never revenue figures or customer data. The plugin stores no personal data.

How do I trigger regeneration from an external system?

Enable a webhook secret in Settings > Advanced. Then POST to /wp-json/llmstxt/v1/regenerate with the header X-LLMSTXT-Key: your-secret.

What happens when I deactivate or delete the plugin?

Deactivating removes the rewrite rules and stops scheduled regeneration. Deleting the plugin additionally removes all stored options and generated files from your server.
sections.changelog:
1.8.7

  • Full GEO audit from the plugin. Pro users get a button that opens the complete audit of their own domain on aiready.tools, signed in with the stored key – the key travels in the request body, never in a URL.
  • Industry FAQ finder. Free and Pro cards link to the free FAQ finder on aiready.tools: 15 typical questions of your industry, checked against your own site text, with answer drafts that only use what your site says.
  • Shorter changelog. The readme now lists the last 12 versions; the full history is in changelog-full.txt inside the plugin folder and at llmstxtgenerator.de/changelog/ (wordpress.org limits this section to 5,000 words).

1.8.6

  • New name and description. The plugin is now “LLMs.txt Generator & AI Visibility by aiready.tools” (same slug, nothing to reinstall). The description now says plainly what sets it apart from link-list generators: real product data, a measured score, the live AI mention check and the GEO audit – and that nobody can guarantee AI citations.
  • Five hard-coded English messages are now translatable (loading/retry/network messages in the score pages, usage-data error) and translated into German, plus three previously missing key-error strings. Checked the whole UI for English text on German installs.
  • Audit limits removed from the texts: audits on aiready.tools are unlimited in all paid plans (fair use).
  • Free 30-day trial. The sidebar in Free mode now offers the trial (Pro Business, no payment details, ends automatically) next to the Pro plans. The trial is started on llmstxtgenerator.de; the key works in the plugin like any Pro key.
  • Trial keys are recognised. With a trial key the Pro card shows “30-day trial active – Pro Business”, the end date and a link to continue with the same key. Key verification now stores the licence end date.
  • German translation for the new texts included. No change to generation, crawling or the data sent.

1.8.5

  • Accurate Pro feature list. The plugin page and this readme no longer promise competitor comparison tables and five file formats. In Pro mode the plugin requests llms.txt and llms-full.txt; comparison tables and the other formats belong to the web generator on llmstxtgenerator.de. The list now names what Pro mode delivers: product data, intent routing, categories and brands, and the crawl of your other pages.
  • “External services” completed. Since 1.8.0/1.8.1 Pro mode also sends the ranked product URLs and the public product data (name, price, availability, brand, SKU, short description). The readme now lists this data and every occasion on which it is sent, including automatic and nightly runs and the Pro score check. What is sent has not changed.
  • German translation for the changed texts included.

1.8.4

  • Clean product descriptions. List items and paragraphs from WooCommerce short descriptions were glued together (“…weightBifacial: …”). They are now separated, in Pro and Free mode, and in page and post excerpts as well.
  • SEO descriptions with a percent sign are used. A Yoast, Rank Math or SEOPress description such as “20 % more runtime” was discarded because of the “%” and the raw short description was sent instead. Only real template variables (%%excerpt%%, %title%) are skipped now; Yoast templates are resolved where Yoast is active.

1.8.3

  • German translation on sites set to “Deutsch (Sie)”. The plugin ships its German texts in the formal form, but loaded them only for de_DE. Sites using de_DE_formal (and de_AT) fell back to the incomplete language pack and showed all newer texts in English. Both now use the bundled translation.
  • After “Generate now” only the first status line is updated; the Product Drill-Down and automatic-update lines keep their content.

1.8.2

  • Automatic updates are bundled and quota-aware. Previously every save started its own regeneration – and WooCommerce saves the product with every order to lower the stock, so a busy shop could use up the daily Pro quota by midday and keep an outdated file until midnight. Now changes mark the file as outdated and one regeneration runs 10 minutes after the last change (at the latest 60 minutes after the first one). In Pro mode automatic runs are at least 2 hours apart.
  • Only changes that are visible in llms.txt count: name, price, sale dates, stock status, descriptions, visibility, categories, SKU and attributes. A stock quantity changing from 12 to 11 no longer triggers a run; a product selling out does.
  • Nightly run at a fixed time between 01:00 and 04:00 (spread per site) picks up shifts in the revenue ranking from new orders.
  • Status on the plugin page: last automatic run with reason, errors if any, and the next scheduled run.
  • Readme: removed two duplicated changelog entries (1.6.3, 1.6.4).

1.8.1

  • Pro mode: product data comes straight from WooCommerce. The plugin now sends name, price, availability, brand, SKU and short description of the selected products — only what your shop already shows publicly, never revenue or sales figures. The generator no longer has to crawl product pages, so on slow shops the time limit is left for your other pages. In 1.8.0 slow shops could end up with products only and no home page, blog, FAQ or legal pages.
  • The home page is always fetched first, so the file title and description never depend on the crawl budget.
  • Honest partial-result notice. The old text said the remaining pages would follow on the next run — there is no such follow-up run. The notice now says what happened and that products are always complete.
  • German interface texts are complete again. WordPress only used the language pack from translate.wordpress.org, so texts added since 1.7.3 appeared in English. The plugin now loads its bundled translations; the German texts consistently use the formal “Sie”.

1.8.0

  • Products are now ranked by net revenue instead of units sold. Until now the product list followed WooCommerce “popularity” (units sold), so metre goods and small parts pushed the real best sellers out of llms.txt — 5,000 metres of cable counted as 5,000 sales. The plugin now uses the net revenue from WooCommerce Analytics for the last 3, 6, 12 or 24 months (default 12). Cancelled, failed and refunded orders do not count. If the analytics tables hold no data for the period, units sold × current price is used as an estimate; the settings page shows which source was used.
  • New filters: only products in stock (default on), minimum price incl. tax (default off), exclude product categories. Accessory-like categories are suggested but never excluded automatically. Products hidden from the catalogue are always left out. New products never win a tie against proven sellers.
  • Separate limits for llms.txt and llms-full.txt (default 50 / 30).
  • Pro mode: the plugin sends the ranked list of product URLs to the generator — no revenue figures leave your site. The server crawls exactly these products first, so the list no longer depends on the crawl budget or sitemap order.
  • New developer filters llmstxt_product_query_args and llmstxt_product_list.

1.7.4

  • Fix: icons on the plugin screens showed as broken images on some sites. WordPress replaces emoji with images from s.w.org on Windows; where that external request is blocked (privacy or consent plugins, CSP, offline admin), the icons broke. The plugin screens now let the browser draw them natively — no external request. Other admin screens are unchanged.

1.7.3

  • Domain check before writing (Pro mode). Before the llms.txt is saved, the plugin checks that its links belong to this site. If the “Source” line or at least half of all links point to another domain (typical after moving from a staging to a live domain), the file is not written and an error notice explains what to do.
  • Automatic regeneration after a domain move. Changing the site address in Settings → General triggers a new generation. Moves done via WP-CLI, migration plugins or a database import are detected as well (checked at most every 6 hours, so a failing run never uses up the API quota).
  • llmstxt_content now also runs in Pro mode. Previously the filter only applied to the free generator; Pro files were written unfiltered. Existing snippets that post-process the files can now use the filter directly.
  • New action llmstxt_after_write ( $filename, $content, $mode ) for your own checks, logs or cache purges.
  • Server side (no update needed for these): product titles now come from the product name without a site-name suffix, HTML entities are decoded, duplicate URLs are removed and sitemap URLs of other domains are ignored.

1.7.2

  • One-time review request in the plugin admin. Seven days after your first successful generation, a single dismissible notice on the plugin’s own pages asks for an honest review on WordPress.org – with “Maybe later” (asks again after 30 days) and “Already rated / don’t ask again” (never again). It is never shown on other admin screens and never blocks anything. The plugin now remembers the date of the first generation and a generation counter; both options are removed on uninstall.
  • German translation for the new strings included.

1.7.1

  • Product Drill-Down badge in the admin is now an HTML/CSS chip instead of a scaled SVG image – readable at every size (the 1.7.0 image rendered too small). No functional changes.

Older versions

  • The full history (1.0.0 – 1.7.0) is in changelog-full.txt inside the plugin folder and at https://llmstxtgenerator.de/changelog/
